summary: Multi-page navigation regression + Parcerias feature verified. Backend 19/19 pytest passed (added 4 partnership tests). Frontend E2E covered nav links (nav-produtos, nav-atletas, nav-sobrenos, nav-parcerias, nav-admin, nav-logo), /produtos with 3 product cards, /produto/:id detail, /atletas with 6 athlete-grid items + CTA to parcerias, /sobre with CTA to produtos, /parcerias form submit -> parceria-success, admin tab-partnerships showing submitted inquiry, and full purchase regression (added to cart -> checkout -> /sucesso/XOKS-1008).
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation testid generator in Navigation.jsx uses a regex that strips spaces AND converts ó->o (e.g. 'Sobre Nós' -> 'sobrenos'). Works but is fragile — if a future label contains other accented chars (á/ç/ã) they'd remain, producing surprising testids. Consider a normalize+slugify helper.
No DELETE endpoint for /api/partnerships or /api/orders — test data accumulates across iterations (cleaned up via direct Mongo access this run).
Partnership form does not validate email format client-side (relies on server 422). Minor UX improvement possible.
Products/athletes/partnerships pages hit their APIs on every mount without any loading skeleton — brief empty state visible on slow networks.
seed_data_creation: Baseline preserved: 3 products, 6 athletes, 0 partnerships. Cleaned test partnerships via Mongo after run. Orders collection now has 8 test orders (no DELETE endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page nav is stable. nav testid for Sobre Nós is 'nav-sobrenos'. Partnership flow: /parcerias parceria-form (pt-name/org/email/phone/type/message) -> pt-submit -> parceria-success; POST /api/partnerships returns Partnership with status='new'. Admin has 4 tabs: tab-orders, tab-products, tab-athletes, tab-partnerships. Baseline: 3 products (xoks-pro-elite, xoks-carbon-blue, xoks-stealth-ankle), 6 athletes (ath-1..ath-6).
